body:
## Summary

Replaces kill-me's bespoke Microsoft sign-in with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life). Microsoft sign-in happens upstream; this app verifies the upstream RS256 JWT against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, gates on the role claim (`admin`/`user` only — `pending` gets 403), and mints its own HS256 session JWT for downstream API calls. Mirrors the canonical template from [tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472).

Closes the kill-me side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16). **Supersedes [#32](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/32)** which predated the canonical template (fetched `/api/auth/token` client-side, POSTed to `/api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft` — both wrong).

## Pattern

- **Frontend** ([frontend/src/auth/index.js](frontend/src/auth/index.js)): `bootstrapAuth → startLogin → logout`. Silent exchange on boot via `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` cookie (the `.romaine.life` session cookie is auto-attached cross-origin). `startLogin` redirects to `${auth_url}/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=...` (GET wrapper, not the POST-only Better Auth route — per tank-operator [#474](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/474)).
- **Backend** ([backend/auth-routes.js](backend/auth-routes.js) + [backend/auth.js](backend/auth.js)): `POST /api/auth/exchange` with `{auth_jwt}` body. `exchangeRomaineLifeToken` verifies RS256 against `https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks` (jose's `createRemoteJWKSet` handles caching), pins issuer = `https://auth.romaine.life`, accepts `role ∈ {admin, user}` only.
- **Local session JWT**: HS256, signed with `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret` (already provisioned in [tofu/keyvault.tf](tofu/keyvault.tf), just newly wired in `config.js`). Carries the upstream role claim through.

## End-to-end deletions (per [tank-operator/docs/migration-policy.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/migration-policy.md))

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| `backend/microsoft-routes.js` | Replaced by `auth-routes.js` |
| `frontend/src/auth/msal.js` | MSAL gone from frontend |
| `@azure/msal-browser` dep | No MSAL imports anywhere |
| `jwks-rsa` dep | Only used for Microsoft JWKS; `jose` replaces it |
| `ALLOWED_EMAIL` constant + hardcoded `nelson-devops-project@outlook.com` | Role claim is the only gate now |
| `config.js` listConfigurationSettings enumeration | No per-app Microsoft client IDs to discover |
| `config.js` read of `api-jwt-signing-secret` | Per-app secret instead |
| Dockerfile + docker-build-check + build-and-deploy `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` | Not in the bundle anymore |
| `tofu/oauth.tf` | The per-app Entra app registration |
| `tofu/appconfig.tf` | Only published `microsoft_oauth_client_id` |
| `tofu/identity.tf` KV scope | Flipped to `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret` |
| CLAUDE.md auth model + data flow + .env docs | Rewritten to describe new flow |

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) greps every committed file for retired patterns (`@azure/msal-browser`, `/auth/microsoft/login`, `ALLOWED_EMAILS`, `api-jwt-signing-secret`, `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`, `microsoft_oauth_client_id`, `jwks-rsa`, etc.) and exits non-zero. Wired as a CI job in `.github/workflows/lint.yaml` so reintroduction breaks at PR time.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run build` succeeds without `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`
- [x] `node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs` returns clean
- [ ] **Phase 0 (auth#18 + auth#19) deployed**: `curl -i -X OPTIONS -H "Origin: https://workout.romaine.life" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` returns ACA header for `workout.romaine.life` (already had it pre-#19)
- [ ] After this image rolls: anonymous visit to `workout.romaine.life` shows snapshot view + Sign-in button
- [ ] Click Sign in → redirects to `auth.romaine.life` → Microsoft completes → returns to `workout.romaine.life` signed in
- [ ] Already signed into another `.romaine.life` app → reload of `workout.romaine.life` silently signs in (no redirect)
- [ ] Admin can log workouts (write path through JWT bearer)
- [ ] Sign Out → cookies cleared on both auth.romaine.life and workout.romaine.life → back to anonymous
- [ ] Demote yourself to `user` in auth.romaine.life/admin → next bootstrap returns 403; demote to `pending` → also 403

## Sequencing notes

- Per migration plan: tofu cleanup of the per-app Entra app reg (already in this PR — `tofu/oauth.tf` deletion) lands with the code PR rather than as a separate follow-up. The infra-bootstrap PR that drops the SPA redirect URIs from the shared `microsoft_login` app reg comes last, after all 6 apps migrate.
- Cosmos records keyed by `microsoft|<MS-sub>` (the old account ID format) won't match the new JWT `sub` (Better Auth's random user.id). For a single-user-class system this is a fresh start; old records sit unreferenced until cleaned up.
